user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by completion status so that I can see only open or only done tasks.

positive.title: Filter tasks to show only open tasks
steps: Select the filter option for 'Open' tasks.
Observe the list of tasks displayed.
positive.expected_result: Only tasks marked as 'open' are displayed.

positive.title: Filter tasks to show only done tasks
steps: Select the filter option for 'Done' tasks.
Observe the list of tasks displayed.
positive.expected_result: Only tasks marked as 'done' are displayed.

negative.title: Filter tasks with no tasks available
steps: Select the filter option for 'Done' tasks where no tasks are done.
Observe the list of tasks displayed.
negative.expected_result: No tasks are displayed with a message indicating no tasks found.

negative.title: Select invalid filter option
steps: Select an invalid filter option (e.g., 'In Progress').
Observe the list of tasks displayed.
negative.expected_result: No tasks are displayed with a message indicating invalid filter option.

edge.title: Filter tasks with a large number of tasks
steps: Navigate to the tasks page with a large dataset (e.g., 1000 tasks).
Select the filter option for 'Open' tasks.
Observe the list of tasks displayed.
edge.expected_result: Only open tasks are displayed efficiently without performance issues.

edge.title: Filter tasks while simultaneously updating task statuses
steps: While the page is open, change some task statuses to 'done' and some to 'open'.
Select the filter option for 'Open' tasks.
Observe the list of tasks displayed.
edge.expected_result: The displayed tasks reflect the updated statuses correctly.
